name: Installed companion demand wake
statement: After an explicitly consented companion installation, an authorized extension can cause a missing or unhealthy native bridge to be safely started or restored through OS-supported mechanisms, then authenticated before privileged operations resume.
requiredProperties: recover on supported running host when activated
retain scoped grants without broadening authority

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
